Notes
*1 Prerequisites
Enable CloudTrail data events on the S3 AP ARN, then create the Athena table with a Glue Crawler or a
manual CREATE TABLE
*2 Retention is controlled on the bucket
Set CloudTrail log retention with the lifecycle policy on the trail bucket
